purpose: Continue raw exact-number accumulation for original 31542-family states while routing substantive physics publications into Worldshepherd independently of Glob evidence weight.

policy.rule: Raw occurrence does not imply physical correspondence.
policy.promotion: Physical evidence requires separately verified quantity, unit and provenance.
policy.worldshepherd_use: Useful scientific methods and datasets are retained even when the target digits occur only in metadata.

records.context: Detection of triboelectric discharges during dust events on Mars
Mass spectroscopy and strong decays of excited open-charm D_J mesons
Coherent THz magnons in an antiferromagnetic insulator triggered by ultrafast spin-phonon interactions
In-vitro ocular platform for contact-lens testing
Multiple NIST Chemistry WebBook chemical records sharing the same five-digit CAS prefix

information_updates.finding: A single generated five-digit state can recur repeatedly as a prefix within one identifier namespace, as demonstrated by multiple NIST CAS records beginning 53907.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Prefix multiplicity within an identifier namespace is not independent evidence.

next_actions: Continue raw-search coverage across remaining union states.
Count repeated prefixes inside one identifier namespace separately from independent domain/source occurrences.
Use Mars discharge and THz-magnon publications for Worldshepherd physical-model references without promoting their DOI digits.
